book.name: Uroma
book.title: Ubvur Uburhu aka atsɛnge abi Uroma

content: Idzin adɔka
Àka ayɛi unerwi imangmangnga iki isi ikerngge, niba awembi ru uning nggu unga ri itsi ubinkpi unga aki ikaifɛrhkɔ.
Imangmang uner uwɔɔ ibemuwe unga agha abina kishoo, bɔr uner uwɔɔ imangmangnga iki isi ikerngge, agha ayerhe ukpekũ.

Unerwi aka agha abina kishoo awu ufang unga niba ayɛɛinga uwuruwi aka asi ighaa, nu unerwi aka asi ighaa abina kishoo awu ufang unga niba akwɛɛrka uwuku ugha abina kishoo, ubinkutsu Unum aka ayɛisa unga.
Ungo ugburh ungamɔ ungo uku itsu uvau ru ugãrhũ uner uwɔɔ? Uteiyanga awuri idɛ̃ɛ̃ atsu unga agba use atsu unga anang. Nggayɛ Uteijee awuri idɛ̃ɛ̃ atsu unga ananga.
Uner uwɔɔ aka isaka anyã unum ukpɔɔ unangkpɔ inum iyɔɔ, inyĩnyã uwɔɔ inuma kishoo iwu ubina unying ru unga. Ubɛn unera adɛ̃ɛ̃ aker ru ubinkpi unga aka ahwɛng.

Unga uwuku unyã unum ukpɔɔ uwu undzuma ru unga, akorhe ri imor Uteijee. Unga uwuku utãi ijuɛ, atãi ri imor Uteijee, ubinkutsu unga atar uwɛɛ ru Unum, nu uwuku ugha ubɛn ubin, akorhe ri imor Uteijee na atar uwɛɛ ru Unum.
Unera asi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ abɛka ri iyike itsinga ukpekũ, ikɛi asi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ akpea ri iyike itsinga ukpekũ.
Uba umɛn ibibɛk, umɛn ibɛk ri idzowe imor ru Uteijee, umɛn ĩba ikpikpe, umɛn ikpe ri idzowe imor ru Uteijee ha. Nggee, umɛn ĩba ibibɛk use akpe, umɛn iwu abi Uteijee ha.
Akɛrɛ ha atsu Ukiristo akpe na abvui awu ru urhɛ, ngge itsú unga awu Uteijee abika akpukpe nu abika abubɛk.
Ungo, mɔcɛ, awu use utsu ungo utsu uvau ru ungwɛ̃mbi use unapumbi? Awu use utsu ungo ukwɛɛte ungwɛ̃mbi use unapumbi? Ubinkutsu kishoo umɛn iwuri idɛ̃ɛ̃ ra anang isei Unum uwuku uvarhuwa arherhamɛn.
Ri itsɛng Arherhu-Num Uteijee agɔr agɛ,

content.text: ubɛn utsurhu uwuri irhupa ra asumum,
ubɛn arhɛm awuri irherhukpɔ ru Unum.>>

content: Nggee, ubɛn unera ru umɛn awuri ivarhunga irhɛ abinkɛ unga aka akorhe ri ibibɛknga ra asu Unum.
Niba utsukɔ ungwɛ̃mbi ubin ikwɛr itok
Nggee umɛn ineke itsu avau ra adɔka. Nu ngge iki iwe rimi, ubɛn unera atsu amɛnnga niba awea utarh ukpuku ukwɛr itok use ubin ukpɔɔ uku uvina ru utsĩndĩ ungwɛ̃mbɔ use unapumbɔ.
Umum ihwɛng ugɛ ru Uteijee Uyesu ubingha ushikpɔ ukpuku usi isarkpɔ. Bɔr unera aba agɔr ugɛ ubin ukpɔɔ usi isarkpɔ, iwe ru unga ubin hã uku usi isarkpɔ.
Ungo uba udakuwe amɛn angwɛ̃mbi ru ubinkpi ungo iki igha, ungo usi ikorhungo amɛn ibibema. Utsur ubinghakpi ungo iki igha udakuwe ungwɛ̃mbi use unapumbi uwuruwi Ukiristo aka akpe ru unga.
Niba uneke ubin uku uze ri inyinyãngo, umbɔ anyã ukpɔ uwe iki ubewe.
Iyɛrhe Unum isi iwengge ighigha nu ihwihwa, bɔr iwu irhirhika, nu ididɔɔr, nu igũibɛn ri Ipfu Isarsatangge.
Ubinkutsu ubɛn unera uwuku utɔ̃itser Ukiristo ru utsĩndĩ uwurɛ, Unum nu anera awuri ibemumbɔ unga.
Nggee umɛn idɛ̃ɛ̃ iker ri ikorha abinkɛ aka ikũwã ididɔɔr ni ifita adɔka.
Niba adakukumbi itser Unum ra arherhe abingha. Abingha kishoo awu asarsatake, bɔr asi izea unera agha ubin uku itsu ikwɛr itok ru uwɔɔ.
Azea ungo niba utãingo ijuɛ, use uhwaɔ adɛ use ukorhe abina akɔɔ aka itsu ungwɛ̃mbi use unapumbi agbaigba.
Nggee ungo uba uweɔ ri imangmang ra akɛrɛ ha, ungo ungwɛ̃ ake ra amɛnngo nggu Unum. Idorh iwu iyi uner ha amɛnnga aka asi itsuke uvau ri itsinga.
Bɔr unerwi aka acang, aba aghaa ubin hã unga aka acang, unga aka agba uvau nukpɔ. Ubinkutsu ighighanga ishingge ri imangmang, nu ubɛn ubinkpi uku ushikpɔ ri imangmang uwu arhim.
